decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records that active Big Block tickets transfer with the NFT to the secondary buyer.
The same-message MODIFY already records active prize-ticket transfer to the secondary buyer.
The existing same-message MODIFY already includes secondary buyers receiving active Small Block tickets in winner eligibility.
The existing same-message FAQ update already states that active prize tickets transfer to the purchaser while expired tickets remain expired.
Transfer of active tickets with NFT ownership does not alter which metadata attributes or counters must be displayed.
The existing same-message MODIFY already identifies secondary buyers who receive active tickets as members of the eligible population.
Ticket ownership transfer does not change the Big Block draw's winner count, prize amount, trigger, qualifying sales, or pool-funding rules.
Transfer of active tickets on a secondary sale does not change primary-mint pricing or revenue allocation.
Transfer of active tickets does not change the amount, enforcement, visibility, or allocation of the secondary-sale royalty.
The source change concerns ownership transfer of active prize tickets and does not modify referral-commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
Transfer of active tickets does not change the one-click winner claim flow or Winners page announcement behavior.
The rule selecting a random existing NFT holder at ticket issuance remains unchanged by later transfer of active tickets with the NFT.
